commands.command: node node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --config prettier.config.mjs --check <the six amended documents and the new task record>

evidence: Operator model amended in six documents: Claude is the primary Founder operator and the Founder is the named independent reviewer; the co-primary Codex role is removed from forward-looking governance

Phase 0 boundary generalized rather than narrowed. AGENTS.md, constitution.md line 146, multi-agent-coordination-policy.md line 122, and stoic-iris-project-context.md lines 34 and 249 now bind every external coding agent including Claude, so removing Codex by name cannot be read as releasing Claude

Self-certification prohibition strengthened, not weakened. AGENTS.md retains the producer prohibition and adds an explicit rule that Claude never records itself as independent reviewer of an objective it produced; the coordination policy adds the same at line 19

Historical attribution preserved. The only remaining Codex references in changed files are the amendment note plus two factual records: claude-onboarding-runbook.md line 93 and stoic-iris-project-context.md line 106, both describing work Codex actually performed
evidence/** and every completed coordination record are unmodified; git status shows only the six amended documents and the two new coordination records
The coordination policy is versioned 1.1.0 proposed with an unchecked Founder decision block; version 1.0.0 remains canonical until the Founder records approval
Formatting passes for all changed paths and the new task record conforms to task.schema.json
limitations: Scope was bounded to the active operator model. Eighteen Codex references remain across docs/specifications/**, two in docs/architecture/decisions/**, and one in docs/registries/**; most describe decisions or cycles as they stood at the time. They were neither audited nor amended here and need a separate bounded pass

Removing the second agent operator removes the only party that could independently review Claude without Founder attention. The Founder now personally holds a role previously shared, which is a real throughput cost accepted by explicit instruction
The producer of this amendment is the party the amendment benefits. That conflict cannot be resolved by the producer and is the reason no self-approval is recorded

pnpm verify was not run in this worktree because dependencies are not installed there; the change is Markdown and JSON only, so format:check is the sole verify stage that inspects it, and the equivalent check was run directly
The certification program at docs/operations/cycle-twelve-founder-certification-program.md still names Codex as audit-only during activated runs. It is excluded from this task and unchanged
rollback: The change is additive documentation on a feature branch with no merge. To discard: close the pull request, then run `git worktree remove C:/Projects/STOIC-IRIS-operator-model` and `git push origin --delete iris/founder-reviewer-operator-model` from C:/Projects/STOIC-IRIS. Canonical main is untouched at 33d928256e78b5e753d7ffd7699d6dbc4a7e520c. If later merged, revert with `git revert -m 1 <merge-commit>`, which preserves history and restores version 1.0.0 wording.

Merge of the pull request into main, which this task record excludes from producer authority
